name: cavemio-data-table
title: Data table
description: A table whose rows travel: sort and every row glides to its rank, live data re-ranks itself, and selection turns the toolbar into its actions.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The table is a grid: arrow keys move between rows and into cells, Home and End jump, Space selects the row (Shift for a range), Enter edits an editable cell or opens the row, Page Up and Page Down change page. Headers carry aria-sort.
- Sorting, the number of matches, selection, removals, Undo, saves and failures are announced in a status region; the drawing checkboxes, rolling counts and sliding toolbar are what you see.
- Rows move with transforms only. Their places are layout offsets kept after every render and whenever the list changes size, so a glide always starts from where the row really was, even mid-glide.
- Below 34rem of container width each row becomes a card: columns marked card: "title", "subtitle" and "trailing" fill it, and sorting moves to a native select in the toolbar.
- Reduced motion changes rows, pages and the toolbar in place; colours, ticks and the announcements still say what happened.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: columns
props.description: – · { key, header, value?, cell?, align?, width?, sortable?, searchable?, editable?, card? }. value is what sorts, searches and edits (defaults to row[key]); cell is what shows.

props.name: rows
props.description: – · Your rows. Change them any time (new data, a subscription) and the table glides whatever moved.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: row.id · A stable id per row: it's what lets a row glide instead of jumping.

props.name: noun
props.description: ["row", "rows"] · What a row is called in the count, the toolbar and announcements.

props.name: searchable
props.description: true · Shows the search field; it looks in columns marked searchable, or all of them.

props.name: selectable
props.description: false · A drawn checkbox per row and in the header; Shift-click selects a range.

props.name: selected / defaultSelected / onSelectedChange
props.description: – · Selected row ids, controlled or not.

props.name: actions
props.description: – · { id, label, progress?, tone?, removes?, run }. Shown in the toolbar while rows are selected; run gets the selected rows. A removing action takes them out at once and runs after undoFor.

props.name: undoFor
props.description: 5000 · How long Undo is offered after a removing action, ms.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: – · Saves an edited cell (columns with editable). Throw to put the old value back.

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: – · Rows open into this, with a chevron at the end of each.

features.title: Sort and search
features.description: Click a header and every row glides to its rank. Search folds away what stops matching while the count rolls.

features.title: Live data
features.description: When your rows change, the table re-sorts itself and rows glide past each other instead of jumping.

features.title: Bulk actions with Undo
features.description: Tick rows (Shift for a range) and the toolbar becomes their actions. A delete holds an Undo for five seconds before it runs.

features.title: Edit in place
features.description: Double-click a cell to edit it. A save draws a check, and a failure puts the old value back.

features.title: Detail rows and pages
features.description: A row opens into its detail by measured height, and pages slide in from the side you went.

features.title: Cards on narrow screens
features.description: Below 34rem of container width each row becomes a card.

states.title: sort
states.description: A header click sorts (numbers and dates descending first, text ascending) and every row that changed rank glides there in 480ms, 16ms after the row above it (up to 200ms). The arrow turns with a slight overshoot.

states.title: live
states.description: Whenever rows change, each row glides from where it was in the layout to where it is, as an added offset, so a change landing mid-glide never restarts one. New rows fade in through a blur 90ms later, as the rows below glide clear.

states.title: search
states.description: Rows that stop matching leave a copy that folds out where it stood (280ms) while the rest close up; the count rolls and the list's height eases to fit. With nothing left, "No customers match …" takes the place of the rows.

states.title: select
states.description: A tick draws itself; the toolbar's search slides up and out as "1 selected" and the actions slide in, its tint shifting to the primary. Shift-click ticks every row between, 28ms apart, starting from the last one you clicked.

states.title: remove
states.description: A removing action folds the rows out at once and the toolbar reads "3 customers deleted · Undo" over a thin line that drains in 5s (paused while you hover it). Undo brings them back in place; when it runs out, the action runs, and if it throws they come back with a note.

states.title: edit
states.description: Double-click an editable cell, or Enter on it, and it becomes a field in place. Enter saves: the new value morphs in with a spinner that turns into a drawn check; if onEdit throws the cell shakes and the old value returns.

states.title: detail
states.description: The chevron (or Enter on the row) opens the row into its detail by grid rows 0fr → 1fr in 420ms; the chevron turns with a slight overshoot and the content fades in 120ms later.

states.title: pages
states.description: The next page slides in 28px from the side you went toward through a blur; "9–16 of 24" rolls.
